'''4-B4''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. It accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dajjun]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Karii]], and a number of other Jedi on a mission to the planet [[Kailion]]. It was caught with the Jedi when they were trapped in a cave-in.<ref name="Peril" />

==Behind the scenes==
The miniature used to represent 4-B4 in this scenario is a [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7]] droid; however, it is not clear whether this is intended to be 4-B4's actual model.<ref name="Peril" />
